title: B Look, complete and say
text: 1 The snail ______ to climb the tall tree.
5 Finally, the snail ______ at the top of the tree.
Long ago, a bird and a snail were in a garden. The snail wanted to see the garden from the top of the tree. ...
What was difficult for the snail? What did it do?
sentences: The snail began to climb the tall tree.
Finally, the snail was at the top of the tree.
It saw many trees and flowers.
